scope_guards: A chemical inventory is not treated as hazardous substances consent.
Hazardous substances consent is not treated as COMAH compliance.
A COMAH notification is not treated as an accepted safety report.
HSE planning advice is not treated as the planning authority decision.
Planning permission is not treated as environmental permitting.
Construction completion is not treated as authorised substance presence.
A stated inventory is not treated as measured operational compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact consent, permits, inventory, construction, operation and inspection evidence.
